subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

F is the immediate neighbour of both E and C. E sits second to the right of G. A is sitting to the immediate left of G. G is the immediate neighbour of both A and B. D sits to the immediate right of C.

The position(s) of how many persons will remain unchanged if all persons are arranged in the English alphabetical order in clockwise direction, starting from A (including A)?
solution:
**Given:**

A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

F is the immediate neighbour of both E and C.

E sits second to the right of G.

A is sitting to the immediate left of G.

G is the immediate neighbour of both A and B.

D sits to the immediate right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/609f87071a1909f21e1d07a5c8143a2a41893bbca99ddecb3ebfcaf6d24446d2.png] 

**Final Arrangement:**

 
 

 A
 G
 B
 E
 F
 C
